title_original: 지방교육행정기관의 행정기구와 정원기준 등에 관한 규정 시행규칙
full_text:
Article 2 (Operation of Temporary Organizations, etc.)
(1) Where a superintendent of education intends to extend the period of existence of a temporary organization under Article 7 (4) of the Regulations on the Administrative Organizations and Personnel Standards of Local Educational Administrative Agencies (hereinafter referred to as the "Decree"), the superintendent shall examine whether such extension is absolutely necessary, including by conducting an organizational diagnosis, beginning six months before the expiration of the period of existence.
(2) Beginning six months before the expiration of the period of existence of a temporary organization, the superintendent of education shall formulate measures for resolving any personnel surplus that would arise from the abolition of that organization. Beginning three months before the expiration of the period, where a vacancy arises in a grade corresponding to the grade of surplus personnel, the superintendent shall give priority in appointment to persons among such surplus personnel.
